scope: Active P1/P2/P3 only. (For this device-only company, equivalent stages mapped: Pivotal IDE = highest_phase 'Pivotal (PMA-enabling)'; Early Feasibility Study = 'Early Feasibility (EFS)'.)

website.note: No /pipeline page (404). Homepage describes DurAVR THV and references PARADIGM, EMBARK, EFS but does not list NCT IDs.

ctgov.note: Initial sponsor query 'Anteris' returned 0 results; corporate sponsor name on ctgov is 'Anteris Technologies Ltd.' Manual ctgov lookup of DurAVR returned 4 active company-sponsored studies (NCT07194265 PARADIGM, NCT06510855 EU-EFS, NCT05712161 US-EFS, NCT05182307 EMBARK first-in-human).
active_studies_used: NCT05182307 (EMBARK first-in-human, UNKNOWN status on ctgov but described as ongoing in 10-K)

pipeline.modality: Class III medical device — balloon-expandable transcatheter aortic valve (TAVR) made from a single piece of molded bovine pericardium treated with proprietary ADAPT anti-calcification tissue technology, delivered via the ComASUR balloon-expandable Delivery System
pipeline.license_origin: Internally developed (ADAPT tissue, DurAVR valve, ComASUR delivery system); Anteris is sole owner of related patent portfolio.

indications.indication: Symptomatic severe aortic stenosis (transcatheter aortic valve replacement)
indications.trial_design: Global, prospective, randomized, controlled, multicenter head-to-head trial vs. commercially available THVs across ~80 centers in US/Canada/Europe; first all-comers TAVI trial designed to evaluate post-procedure blood flow patterns using cardiac MRI
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING. First patients enrolled October 2025 (Denmark). FDA granted IDE approval November 2025 for staged enrollment of first 200 US patients.
key_milestones: Nov 2025 - FDA IDE approval (staged, first 200 US patients)
Trial intended to support global regulatory approval (US PMA + ex-US)

indications.indication: Severe aortic stenosis - small annulus / valve-in-valve population (Early Feasibility evaluation)
indications.trial_design: Multi-center early feasibility study; 15 patients enrolled across 4 US sites
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. 100% implant success, no mortality / disabling stroke / life-threatening bleeding at 30 days. 30-day pooled data published in EuroIntervention.

indications.indication: Severe aortic stenosis - EU early feasibility / valve-in-valve (ViV) safety and performance
indications.trial_design: Multi-center early feasibility study in EU; 15 patients enrolled to evaluate safety and ViV performance
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. Pooled with US EFS for 30-day publication.

indications.trial_design: First-in-human, multi-cohort study initiated November 2021 in Tbilisi, Georgia; 9 cohorts enrolled including de novo, ViV, and complex anatomies (e.g., bicuspid aortic valve)
indications.trial_status: Ongoing per FY2025 10-K (over 130 patients treated to date across all DurAVR studies including compassionate use); ctgov status listed as UNKNOWN.
key_milestones: 9 cohorts enrolled - consistent device performance and acceptable safety profile per 10-K

approved_or_marketed.name: ADAPT tissue (component / supply)
approved_or_marketed.indication: Used clinically for over 10 years in 55,000+ patients globally as a tissue component (e.g., supplied to 4C Medical Technologies for mitral/tricuspid devices; previously CardioCel - now divested to LeMaitre)
approved_or_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA-cleared tissue technology; 4C supply agreement non-renewed effective for next renewal term (notified Nov 2025).

preclinical_partner_programs.name: v2vmedtech TEER Product (transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral/tricuspid repair)
preclinical_partner_programs.status: Stage 2 of 5-stage development; concept lock on clips and coupler. First-in-human timing not yet determinable.
preclinical_partner_programs.ownership: Anteris owns 30% of v2vmedtech; underlying Columbia University license to v2vmedtech.
preclinical_partner_programs.exclusion_reason: Preclinical (pre-FIH); excluded from active P1/P2/P3 pipeline.

excluded_preclinical: v2vmedtech TEER mitral/tricuspid repair device (Stage 2 of 5; pre-FIH)
excluded_partner_owned: 4C Medical Technologies mitral/tricuspid devices using ADAPT tissue (Anteris is supplier only; 4C agreement non-renewed November 2025)
